formulas.tex: \term{wetness}{\mathrm{TWI}} = \ln\frac{\term{catchment}{a}}{\term{tangent}{\tan\beta}},\quad a = \frac{\term{area}{A}}{\sqrt{\Delta x\,\Delta y}},\quad \tan\beta = \max\bigl(\term{steepest}{s},\ \term{minimumSlope}{s_{\min}}\bigr),\quad s = \max_k \frac{z_c - z_k}{d_k},\quad \mathrm{SPI} = a \tan\beta
formulas.ascii: TWI = ln(a / tanB); a = A / sqrt(groundX * groundY) at the cell row, A = contributing area in m2 incl. the cell; tanB = max(s, minimumSlope), s = max over valid neighbours of (z - zk) / d_k, floor 0; SPI = a * tanB; NaN where the cell or A is not finite; a <= 0 gives -Infinity
